title: coordinate-multi-sdk-iterable-cred-handoff-and-version-symphony
author: Amina Patel
description:
Context and goal: This PR coordinates ergonomics and auth/retry surface parity across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs with a targeted version bump for downstream consumers. Motivation came from multiple customer integrations that relied on a consistent async-iterable streaming model and predictable credential handoff semantics for session migration. The changeset bundles: 1) an ergonomic async/pullstream adapter that standardizes how SDKs expose resumable iterables (supports checkpoint metadata and graceful cancel). 2) a thin credential handoff contract (token-prefetch + lease metadata) that enables in-flight session transfer between host processes (used by Dedicated/Private agents). 3) a small set of retry-presets and backoff defaults that match the platform's resilient defaults. 4) synchronized version bumps for py/ts/go to avoid mismatch when customers use multi-language projects. The description below is a continuous narrative; specific lists are embedded inline.

What changed (high-level):
- Python SDK (v3.2.0): added AsyncPullstreamFacade, SessionLease metadata on stream events, helper utilities in sdk.auth.session for prefetch and lease renewal, updated retry presets to include `balanced_latency` and `throughput_safe`. Deprecation: callback-based streaming helpers marked deprecated in favor of async iterables.
- TypeScript SDK (v1.28.4): added `createPullstream()` typed generator, `SessionLease` on StreamEvent envelope, new `retryProfiles` export with presets, improved TS generics for stream cursors to tighten consumer ergonomics.
- Go SDK (v1.9.7): introduced PullIterator interface, SessionLease and LeasePrefetch helper, lightweight session-fanout utility for in-process handoff, small API rename `StreamHandle.Close()` -> `StreamHandle.Shutdown()` for clearer semantics (non-breaking: alias retained).

Commits (summary):
- feat(py): async pullstream facade + session lease helpers (A. Patel)
- feat(ts): typed generator pullstream + session envelope (D. Ramirez)
- feat(go): pull iterator + lease prefetch (M. Vogel)
- chore: align retry presets and tests across sdks
- docs: examples for cross-lang session handoff and migration guide
- chore(release): bump py->3.2.0 ts->1.28.4 go->1.9.7

Files / areas touched (high-level):
- sdk/python/src/redwood_sdk/streaming.py (new AsyncPullstreamFacade)
- sdk/python/src/redwood_sdk/auth/session.py (SessionLease, prefetch helpers)
- sdk/typescript/src/stream/pullstream.ts (generator implementation + types)
- sdk/typescript/src/auth/session.ts (envelope typings + examples)
- sdk/go/stream/pulliterator.go (new interface + helpers)
- sdk/go/auth/lease.go (lease prefetch and fold helpers)
- docs/examples/multi-lang/session-handoff.md (new guide)
- tests/* (unit + integration updates across sdks)

CI and testing notes: Initial CI run flagged two flaky tests: `test_stream_cancelation` (py) and `TestPullIterator_Timeout` (go). Flakes were due to timing assumptions in previous tests and were fixed by switching to event-based waits and widening test timeouts for CI runners. After reruns all checks passed. Linting: fixed a handful of TS lint warnings and standardized docstrings across Python.

Review conversation (highlights):
- Diego Ramirez (reviewer): "Nice alignment work — can we ensure the SessionLease struct will be forwards-compatible if we add fields? Suggest versioned envelope metadata."
  - Amina: "Added `lease_version` field and a de/serialization helper; left fallbacks for unknown versions to preserve forward compatibility."
- Olivia Chen: "TS generics look good; consider naming `createPullstream` -> `createPullStream` for camelCase consistency."
  - Amina: "Agreed; kept camelCase and added a backward-compatible export alias for the previous name in the minor bump."
- Markus Vogel: "Go API rename looks fine; please add an alias in the next minor to avoid breakage."
  - Amina: "Added alias and a short migration note in the changelog."

Runtime / behavior: The new pullstream adapters provide: a) structured envelope with `type`, `payload`, `session_lease` (optional), b) a lightweight way to checkpoint offsets for later resume, c) cancel semantics that surface as a `Shutdown()` call in Go, `aclose()` in Python, and `return()` in generator consumers in TS. Backoff/retry: default profiles are conservative for hosted usage but include `balanced_latency` for interactive workloads; these align with Redwood Optimize recommendations.

Compatibility and migration notes:
- This PR is additive across all three SDKs; we introduced aliasing for renamed APIs to keep the change non-breaking for one minor bump. Consumers should adopt the new async iterables for better resource safety and to gain session-lease capabilities. Migration guide added at docs/examples/multi-lang/session-handoff.md.

Release notes (short):
- Add async pullstream/pull-iterator ergonomics and session lease handoff helpers.
- Introduce new retry presets and align defaults across languages.
- Bump SDK versions: py v3.2.0, ts v1.28.4, go v1.9.7.

Merge decision: After two rounds of fixes (tests + minor naming polish) reviewers approved. CI green. Merged via squash to keep history concise.

Related linear tickets: ENG-3219 (session handoff design), ENG-3290 (sdk ergonomics and parity).

Notes for release engineers: Coordinate package publish for all three SDKs in the same release window to prevent cross-language mismatch for teams that pin multiple SDKs.
